lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Harper Lane, twenty-four-year-old night-shift nurse, gasps awake as the flatlining heart monitor abruptly returns to a steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Cole Whitmore, thirty-two-year-old billionaire CEO of Whitmore Shipping posing as a mechanic, grips her hand in overwhelming relief.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You... you paid for my seventeen-year-old sister Mia's heart surgery, and now you own an entire shipping empire.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: I'm sorry I hid my true identity as a billionaire, Harper, but my heart has always belonged to my mechanic wife.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Diane Whitmore, fifty-eight-year-old board member and Cole's stepmother, is led away in handcuffs by federal agents for poisoning Evelyn.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Jake Whitmore, twenty-nine-year-old head of sales and Diane's son, screams curses at the reporters while being dragged into a police cruiser.

lines.speaker: EVELYN
lines.text: Evelyn Whitmore, the late eighty-one-year-old matriarch, left an emergency video clause naming Harper as the controlling shareholder.

lines.speaker: ATTORNEY
lines.text: The company's legal counsel plays Evelyn's final recorded decree transferring all voting shares directly to Cole and Harper.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: Mia Lane rushes through the door with a doctor's report, shouting that Harper's pregnancy status is severely compromised by the shooting.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Cole stands protectively over his recovering wife, vowing to protect both Harper and their unborn child at any cost.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Harper suddenly clutches her lower abdomen in agonizing pain as the hospital room door is kicked open by an armed hitman.
